'''Rethban Caverns''' is an extensive series of caverns which extend deep into the northwestern section of the [[Redridge Mountains]]. Adventurers sometimes visit the caverns in search of [[Rethban Ore]], which can be found in the possession of the local [[gnoll]]s who are led by the cunning [[Ardo Dirtpaw]].

The caverns may have been named after [[Bart Rethban]].
